system.name: ARIES
system.one_liner: Corpus of reviewer comments linked to the paper edits made in response, with comment-edit alignment and edit generation tasks.

content.variant_note: shared inputs on the left feed two stacked task rows, Alignment and Generation, each through a black-box model to real example outputs on the right
content.argues: Given a review comment and a source paper, a model must either pick the revised-paper edits that answer it (alignment) or write such an edit itself (generation).
content.subject: A review comment and paper versions feeding two black-box tasks, comment-edit alignment and edit generation, with real example edits.

encoding.shape_means: Rounded box = a model or a text item; short pill bar = an edit; page with scribbles = a document; tick and cross card = alignment outcome.

lessons.what_to_learn: Define two related tasks by fanning the same inputs into two stacked rows (input chips, black-box model, example output) and tie compact bars to full-text examples by dotted leaders; a tick and cross card shows what an alignment output looks like.
lessons.suits: Dataset or task papers that define more than one task over the same inputs and want the reader to see real input and output text.

evidence: In edit generation, a model is given a review comment and a source paper and must generate an edit
we consider two versions of the task of determining how a document should be edited

summary: ARIES is a dataset of reviewer comments linked to the edits authors made to their papers in response; it defines two tasks and benchmarks ten models. Figure 1 draws both tasks from shared inputs. A yellow note holds a real review comment, and dashed lines tie it to the source paper and to the paper with its revisions, drawn as page thumbnails. In the Alignment row, the comment chip and three blue bars of candidate edits enter a lilac model box whose output is a tick, tick, cross card linked to a gold aligned edit and a not-aligned edit. In the Generation row, the comment and the source paper enter a model that outputs a generated edit with placeholders. Edits are shown in monospace with green insertions and red deletions.
summary_zh: ARIES 把审稿意见与作者随后的论文修改配成数据集。图 1 以一条真实意见为例，从共同输入分出两个任务：对齐任务由模型给候选修改打勾叉并对应到金标准修改，生成任务则由模型写出带占位符的修改，修改文本用绿增红删标注。
notes: Prior labels kept (stage-pipeline, fan-out); worked-walkthrough added because the comment and the edits are real text traced through both rows. Alignment and Generation are treated as two lanes of one drawing, not as panels (the index says one panel, the earlier pass two). The person icon is unlabelled; its meaning is read from its position on the dashed link. There are no arrowheads: the digest counts none.
